text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I ran, I made it to the end...! I 
finished the run, butttt...—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmph, uggh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Bleh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this is the worst!!

Right after crossing the finish line, 
Fusaichi Pandora collapsed. Fortunately, 
it wasn't serious, and a brief rest got 
her back on her feet. However—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Collapsing after a run is just so lame. 
Besides, I was already feeling kinda sick 
while running~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And it was the Oka Sho, too...! Waaah!

"Due to poor condition, it wasn't the 
ideal run for her."
choice_data_list: (And it was the Oka Sho, of all races...)

text_block_list.text:
It was a crucial, once-in-a-lifetime race 
that Fusaichi Pandora took on as she grew.

Shouldn't a Trainer, of all people, have 
been able to anticipate the trouble?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……? What's wrong, Trainer? Does your tummy 
hurt?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, ...was that so?

I knew the results of the Hanshin 
Umamusume Stakes. It didn't take much 
thought to imagine how pumped up Fusaichi 
Pandora would be.
choice_data_list:
My apologies for not being able to follow 
you back
Sorry I couldn't follow you back

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that how it is? Ehh... really~?

...I started to say, but seeing her 
troubled expression brought me back to my 
senses.
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry, I'm not feeling down at all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Aha.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Geez, that's such a totally fake smile!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm so glad we picked a nice hotel! 
This huge bath feels a-ma-zing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Agh, still... that's so frustrating! I 
seriously could've done way better! Argh!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(............ I mean, isn't Trainer 
getting way too depressed? Their face is 
totally pale.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......I mean.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Aren't they, like, clinging to me a bit 
too much? Making me nutritious lunches and 
snacks every single time...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(You forget your own shoes, but you buy 
mine right away, and you try to run 
alongside me—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You found the accessory I lost in the 
woods?! —Wait, did you stay up all night 
looking for it?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I did say I wouldn't have any motivation 
without it, but still...! It flew off 
during our perimeter run, so I'd already 
given up on it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I know. It's fine... Just sit down and 
rest for a bit today."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Painkillers? —The kind that are 
gentle on the stomach?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This one is... Stretches for stiff 
shoulders? Along with lifestyle 
improvement tips and a list of recommended 
foods.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean, I did say I had a headache 
earlier... but still...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...And stuff like that... Even today, 
they didn't get mad that I was late. If 
anything, they were worried...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Like, how do I even put this...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ... Trainer, aren't you way too into me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I am terribly sorry for startling you 
earlier."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I ran in the Hanshin Umamusume Stakes 
yesterday. I decided to stay an extra 
night so I could watch the Oka Sho before 
heading home, and while I was doing 
that...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So you were staying at the same hotel.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Air Messiah-chan... She's in the same 
generation as Kuu-chan-senpai, and she 
cares deeply about her mom, right?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry for shouting so loudly myself. 
Everyone was staring, haha..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, pardon me for saying so, but I 
can't quite let what you just said slide."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Um... From your dedicated Trainer...?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no, no! When I asked if you're 'too 
obsessed', I didn't mean it like that!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Like, how do I put it? I can't say it 
well, but for example, y'know...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you devotedly look after 
her day in and day out, and when it comes 
to Pandora-san, you become even more 
serious than when it's about yourself...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Yeah. Something like that, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
When I picture what an "ordinary trainer" 
looks like, y'know what comes to mind?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So it's like, put together a training 
plan, discuss rotations, and do our best 
in races?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, isn't your angle kinda off? I'm 
thinking... aren't you a little too 
obsessed with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
May I tell you one thing? It's a story 
about my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...I respect my mother more than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not just her presence on the turf, but her 
very way of life serves as a model for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—On the other hand, even now, Mother often 
still fusses over me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, that's unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I am still very much a child. I 
receive all kinds of care, sometimes 
without even realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I go home, the fridge is full of 
my favorites. And in the winter, they send 
warm wool sweaters... ones that are just a 
little too cute.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A soft futon, a toothbrush that doesn't 
fray, barley tea that never spoils, 
always-stocked tissues. The environment is 
constantly arranged for us before we even 
realize it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is not merely the environment. More 
than I do myself, they rejoice in my 
triumphs and share in my sorrows—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And you always take everything about me 
far more seriously than I ever could.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I-I think my mom and dad…… are kinda like 
that too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you notice a resemblance between 
this and how Trainer-san acts?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Devotedly supporting others, not 
hesitating at self-sacrifice. Empathizing 
with pain, yet never showing one's own."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...As you hold the position of 'Trainer,' 
I imagine you must draw a line to some 
extent.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I wonder if the compassion and 
affection in my heart... might actually be 
close to "parental love."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: This is purely my conjecture, however.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Fuheee~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(It's not like what Dad and Mom do... They 
don't give me daily necessities, and 
besides, Mom and Dad let me do whatever I 
want and buy me anything.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Still――)
"...Her slump is my responsibility."
"...Her slump is my responsibility."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Similarities, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Oh, so that's how it was. I 
thought something felt off.”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Fufu, parental love, huh~...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(—Come to think of it, Mom and Dad were 
always suuuper happy whenever I did 
something amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Pan-chan, I heard you came in 1st place in 
today's mock race at the club~?!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing, isn't that amazing! 
That's our Pan-chan for you, a total 
genius~!

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehehe♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehehehehehe~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All right! Guess it can't be helped, maybe 
next time I'll make sure to give you 
something to be happy about~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright~☆ Let's do our best today too, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Oh, you're full of fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mm, pretty much! ...Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks"♡ I'm definitely gonna win, so 
keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Look at that smile~! Alrighty, off to 
do outer-ring laps, byeee!

"Was the result of the Oka Sho truly that 
frustrating for her after all...?"
choice_data_list: (I've got to do my best, too!)

text_block_list.text:
In any case, next is the Oaks. To seize 
that radiant tiara, our days of running 
forward together had begun!
